subject: Re: Accessing dataset one has uploaded

messages.subject: Re: Accessing dataset one has uploaded
parts:
I think the problem is that in your renderPlot, you're using read.csv(), but not saving the returned value anywhere.

You're probably better of using a reactive expression to load the file, instead of loading it twice. Something like this:

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  inData <- reactive({
    inFile <- input$dataset
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep, quote=input$quote)
  })

  output$contents <- renderTable({
    inData()
  })
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    plot(inData())
  })
})


-Winston



On Thu, Aug 15, 2013 at 4:36 AM, <chris...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi!
I am trying to upload a datafile, which works using the tutorial on the homepage of shiny, but when I want to plot it, I cant manage to accessing the dataset.
In general I have always used local files, and accessing these have never been a problem, but in this case, I just can't seem to manage...

-Chris

#server.R
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  
  output$contents <- renderTable({
   inFile <- input$dataset  
    if (is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep, quote=input$quote)
  })
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    inFile <- input$dataset
    if(is.null(inFile))
      return(NULL)
    read.csv(inFile$datapath, header=input$header, sep=input$sep, quote=input$quote)
    plot(inFile[,1])
    })
  
})

#ui.R
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  
  headerPanel("CSV Viewer"),    # HEAD TITLE
  
  sidebarPanel(                 # SIDEBAR
    wellPanel(
    fileInput('dataset', 'Choose CSV File', # FILEINPUT
              accept=c('text/csv', 'text/comma-separated-values,text/plain')),
    tags$hr(),
    checkboxInput('header', 'Header', TRUE),
    radioButtons('sep', 'Separator',
                 c(Comma=',',
                   Semicolon=';',
                   Tab='\t'),
                 'Comma'),
    radioButtons('quote', 'Quote',
                 c(None='',
                   'Double Quote'='"',
                   'Single Quote'="'"),
                   'Double Quote')
    )
  ),
  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id="tabs",
    tabPanel("Table", tableOutput('contents')),
    tabPanel("Plot", plotOutput('plot'))
    )
  )
))
